# Situation
The northeast pylon was on the north shore.
The northwest pylon was on the north shore.
The station was at Circular Quay.
The east wharf was near the station.
The west wharf was near the Opera House.
Blues Point Tower was on the north shore.
Echo can not see Blues Point Tower.
Echo can not see the northwest pylon.
# Order — Control to Echo
Fly to the wharf near the station.
Fly to the wharf.
Fly to Blues Point Tower.
Fly to the station and land near the northeast pylon.
Fly to the northwest pylon.
